item.title: Experts say powering data centers uses more water than cooling them
item.description: Fears about data center water use are especially acute in Arizona. But keeping servers cool uses a lot less water than generating the electricity for which data centers are so thirsty.

item.title: Business opportunity or security threat? Nvidia case raises questions about China
item.description: The Nvidia case illustrates the friction between Silicon Valley, which wants to sell high-tech products to China, and the national security community, which aims to restrict U.S. tech to China.
